name: mikkilens
description: Hands-free, voice-operated YouTube stream control for VTubers

scripts.build: npm run build:daemon && npm run build:desktop
scripts.package: npm run build:daemon && npm run fetch:wake && npm run package --workspace @mikkilens/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:go && npm run test:desktop
scripts.test:desktop: npm run typecheck --workspace @mikkilens/desktop && npm run build --workspace @mikkilens/desktop && npm run test:commands --workspace @mikkilens/desktop
scripts.package:dir: npm run build:daemon && npm run fetch:wake && npm run package:dir --workspace @mikkilens/desktop
scripts.release: npm run build:daemon && npm run fetch:wake && npm run release --workspace @mikkilens/desktop
